fact_text: Oman's work visa is granted only at the request and on the responsibility of an employer to a foreigner coming to Oman for employment; the individual cannot apply for it on their own behalf.
evidence_quote: It is granted at the request and on the responsibility of an employer to a foreigner who is coming to Oman for employment.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the relocating employee applies for their own Oman work visa. Actually it is issued only at the request and under the legal responsibility of a sponsoring employer. Action: have the Omani employer initiate and own the visa application; the employee cannot self-petition.

entity_title: Ministry of Manpower labour permit prerequisite
fact_text: Before a work visa is issued, a labour permit (labour clearance) from the Ministry of Manpower is required, unless the foreigner is invited by a government organization. The Ministry of Manpower's functions now sit under the Ministry of Labour.
evidence_quote: Unless the foreigner is invited by a government organization a labour permit from the Ministry of Manpower is needed.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed a single work-visa application covers everything. Actually a separate labour permit from the Ministry of Manpower (now the Ministry of Labour) must exist first; only government-invited foreigners are exempt. Action: secure the labour clearance before filing the visa.

entity_title: Sponsor must be a local entity
fact_text: The work-visa sponsor must be a local one with full legal competence; a foreign parent company cannot itself be the sponsor.
evidence_quote: The sponsor must be a local one with full legal competence.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the overseas employer can sponsor the relocation directly. Actually the sponsor must be a locally established entity with full legal competence. Action: route sponsorship through the Omani-registered employing entity, not the foreign HQ.

entity_title: Visa occupation must match labour permit
fact_text: The occupation stated in the work-visa application must be the same as the occupation on the labour permit, tying the visa to a specific role.
evidence_quote: The occupation mentioned in the visa application shall be the same as in the labour permit.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed a hired professional can be deployed flexibly across roles. Actually the visa occupation must match the labour-permit occupation. Action: make the labour-permit job title match the intended role before applying, and re-permit before any role change.

fact_text: The person for whom a work visa is requested must not be below 21 years of age.
evidence_quote: The person for whom the work visa is requested shall not be below 21.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed any working-age adult qualifies. Actually applicants under 21 are ineligible for the work visa. Action: confirm the assignee is at least 21 before initiating sponsorship.

fact_text: A medical certificate (original and copy) is required for work-visa applicants who are nationals of certain listed countries (India, Pakistan, Philippines, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Egypt, Sudan, Ethiopia, Syria and Nepal); per the same page it must be attested by the Ministry of Health.
evidence_quote: The original and copy of the medical certificate for nationals of certain countries: India, Pakistan, Philippine, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Egypt, Sudan, Ethiopia, Syria and Nepal.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed every foreign hire must pass an Oman medical exam, or that none do. Actually the work-visa medical certificate is required only for nationals of a specific list of countries, and must be attested by the Ministry of Health. Action: check whether the assignee's nationality is on the list; if so, obtain and attest the medical certificate.

entity_title: Release letter if re-entering within two years
fact_text: If the foreigner previously worked in Oman and has not yet completed two years since their last departure, a release letter from the previous employer, approved by the Directorate General of Passports and Residence, is required.
evidence_quote: Where the foreigner worked in Oman and has not yet completed two years of their last departure, a release letter from the previous employer

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed you can freely return to Oman on a new job at any time. Actually if you last left Oman under two years ago after working there, a release letter from the previous employer (approved by the Directorate General of Passports and Residence) is required. Action: obtain the previous employer's approved release letter for any re-entry within two years of departure.

fact_text: To transfer sponsorship (change employer), a release letter from the previous sponsor, approved by the Ministry of Manpower, is required.
evidence_quote: Where the application is for the transfer of sponsorship, a release letter from the previous sponsor and approved by the Ministry of Manpower is required.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed an expatriate can switch Omani employers freely (the historical 'NOC'). Actually a transfer of sponsorship still requires a release letter from the current sponsor, approved by the Ministry of Manpower (now the Ministry of Labour). Action: secure the previous sponsor's approved release letter before any employer change.

entity_title: Work visa validity two years, multi-entry
fact_text: The work visa is valid for staying in the country for two years from the date it is stamped on the passport, and (per the same page) is a multi-entry visa.
evidence_quote: The visa is valid for staying in the country for 2 years as of the date of stamping on the passport.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed Omani work visas are annual. Actually the work visa is valid for two years from the passport-stamping date and is multi-entry. Action: plan renewal around the two-year stamp date, not the entry or contract date.

entity_title: Residence card mandatory for all foreigners
fact_text: Every foreigner residing in Oman must obtain a residence card; it is issued by the Royal Oman Police.
evidence_quote: Every foreigner residing in Sultanate of Oman shall obtain a residence card.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the residence visa alone is enough to live in Oman. Actually every resident foreigner must additionally obtain a residence (resident) card issued by the Royal Oman Police. Action: obtain the ROP residence card after the residence visa is issued; it is the mandatory ID for expatriates.
